meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把静态设计变成动感短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做短视频或社媒素材，想让画面更有动感
copy.tagline_en: Turn static designs into eye-catching motion shorts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you make short videos or social media content and want more dynamic visuals.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你制作短小的设计型动态图形:比如动态文字、数字滚动、数据图表动画、logo 开场、地图标注、网页或推文动画等,通常 10 秒以内,输出 MP4 或透明叠加视频。整个过程基本自动完成,只在最后询问你要预览还是直接渲染。
howto.when: 当你请它做一段短视频动效、数据图表动画、logo 动效、地图动效等,且内容简短、不需要旁白时触发。若内容较长或带解说,它会转给 /general-video;不确定时先进 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这句话做成动态文字视频,10 秒以内。
say.note: 它会走 kinetic-type 类别制作动态文字。

say.text: 用这份数据做一个柱状图变化动画。
say.note: 它会走 charts 类别,把数据做成图表动画。

say.text: 给这个 logo 做一个品牌开场动效。
say.note: 它会走 logo-reveal 类别制作 logo 动画。

howto.what_en: Claude makes short design-led motion graphics: kinetic type, stat count-ups, charts, logo stings, map animations, webpage/tweet animations, etc. Usually under 10s; renders MP4 or transparent overlay. Asks preview-or-render at end.
howto.when_en: Triggers on short motion-graphic requests: animated text, chart animation, logo reveal, map motion, or UI animation, no narration. Longer/narrated → /general-video; unclear → /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this quote into a kinetic typography video under 10 seconds.
Animate this dataset as a bar chart transition.
Make a logo sting for this brand logo.
